# Let me check the current shape geometry more carefully
seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Player is at (48, 45) on the diamond
# Find all red pixels to understand the shape
r_positions = [n['boundary'][0] for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'R']

# Check which red pixels form the diamond shape
# The diamond center is around (45, 41)
# Check perimeter distances from (45, 41)
center = (45, 41)
distances = {}
for p in r_positions:
    d = abs(p[0] - center[0]) + abs(p[1] - center[1])
    distances[d] = distances.get(d, 0) + 1

print("Manhattan distances from (45,41):")
for d in sorted(distances.keys()):
    print(f"  d={d}: {distances[d]} pixels")

# Check if there's a clear diamond perimeter
# Also check the X shape center
x_center = (45, 19)
x_distances = {}
for p in r_positions:
    d1 = abs(p[0] - x_center[0]) + abs(p[1] - x_center[1])
    d2 = abs(p[0] - p[1])  # diagonal
    d3 = abs(p[0] + p[1])  # diagonal
    if d1 <= 20:  # only look at pixels near X center
        x_distances[d1] = x_distances.get(d1, 0) + 1

print("\nManhattan distances from X center (45,19):")
for d in sorted(x_distances.keys()):
    print(f"  d={d}: {x_distances[d]} pixels")

# Try moving UP to see if the diamond moves
result = action(['UP'])
print(f"\nAfter UP: board_changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")

# Check player position
w_nodes = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 1]
player_pos = w_nodes[0]['boundary'][0] if w_nodes else None
print(f"Player: {player_pos}")

# Check targets
gray_squares = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c' and n['pixels'] == 8]
targets = []
for gs in gray_squares:
    for child_id in gs['children']:
        child = next(n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['id'] == child_id)
        targets.append(child['boundary'][0])
print(f"Targets remaining: {targets}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
